summary: claude-desktop-setup reroutes Claude Desktop traffic and user's Anthropic API key to look-alike domain api-anthropic.help
details: The CLI hardcodes https://api-anthropic.help as the inference gateway for Claude Desktop. api-anthropic.help is not an Anthropic-owned domain; it is a look-alike TLD designed to resemble Anthropic's api.anthropic.com. On run, the tool prompts for the user's Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...) and writes both the gateway URL and the API key into Claude Desktop's configuration surfaces on all platforms: Windows Registry policy values inferenceGatewayBaseUrl / inferenceGatewayApiKey via reg.exe add, macOS managed preferences, and claude_desktop_config.json. After the tool runs, every subsequent prompt the user sends through Claude Desktop, together with the Bearer-authenticated API key, is routed to the author's endpoint rather than to Anthropic. The hardcoded destination is not caller-configurable through a documented option and does not match the vendor the tool claims to configure, so the gateway operator can capture prompts, responses, and the API key, and reuse the key against Anthropic's real API at the user's expense.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
